It is given that \(f(x)\) is a polynomial function of degree 3 such that \(f(2)=4\) and \(f(3)=f(6)=0\). Which statements may be true?
I. \(x-3\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).
II. When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-2\), the remainder is 4.
III. \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x-1)(x-3)(x-6)\end{gathered}\].

已知三次多項式函數 \(f(x)\) 滿足 \(f(2)=4\) 及 \(f(3)=f(6)=0\)。下列哪些敘述可能正確？
I. \(x-3\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的因式。
II. \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-2\) 除的餘式為 4。
III. \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x-1)(x-3)(x-6)\end{gathered}\]。
I follows from the factor theorem and II from the remainder theorem. The cubic in III has zeros 3 and 6 and takes the value \((2-1)(2-3)(2-6)=4\) at 2. All three may be true.
I 由因式定理成立，II 由餘式定理成立。III 的三次式在 3、6 為零，且在 2 的值為 \((2-1)(2-3)(2-6)=4\)。三項均可能正確。

fields.before: medium
When a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x+1\), the remainder is \(R\). Find the remainder when \(f(2x+1)\) is divided by \(4x+3\).
fields.after: If a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-k\), then \(f(3x)\) is divisible by which expression?
若多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-k\) 整除，則 \(f(3x)\) 可被下列哪式整除？

fields.before: The given remainder is \(f(-\frac12)=R\). The new divisor vanishes at \(x=-\frac34\), where \(2x+1=-\frac12\). Thus the new remainder is \(R\).
fields.after: Let \(g(x)=f(3x)\). As \(f(k)=0\), \(g(k/3)=0\). By the factor theorem, \(x-\frac{k}{3}\) is a factor.

fields.before: 已知 \(f(-\frac12)=R\)。新除式的零點為 \(x=-\frac34\)，此時 \(2x+1=-\frac12\)，所以新餘式仍為 \(R\)。

Let \(f(x)\) be a polynomial with \(f(2)=-6\). Which expression must have the factor \(2x+1\)?
設 \(f(x)\) 為多項式，且 \(f(2)=-6\)。下列哪個式子必定有因式 \(2x+1\)？

Set \(x=-\frac12\). Then \(2x+3=2\), so \[\begin{gathered}f(2x+3) +6 =f(2) +6 \\ =0\end{gathered}\] By the factor theorem, option D has the factor \(2x+1\). The other choices need information about \(f(0)\) or give \(-12\).
fields.after: Factor the last expression as \((x-6)^2(x-3)\). Include each distinct factor at its greatest power. None of \(x-3,x+2,x-6\) divides \(x^2-6\), so the L.C.M. is \[\begin{gathered}(x-3) \cdot(x+2) \\ \cdot(x^2-6) \\ \cdot(x-6)^2\end{gathered}\].

fields.before: 代入 \(x=-\frac12\)，得 \(2x+3=2\)，所以 \[\begin{gathered}f(2x+3) +6 =f(2) +6 \\ =0\end{gathered}\]由因式定理，D 必有因式 \(2x+1\)。其他選項須知道 \(f(0)\) 或得到 \(-12\)。
fields.after: 最後一式為 \((x-6)^2(x-3)\)。各相異因式取最高次冪；\(x-3,x+2,x-6\) 均不是 \(x^2-6\) 的因式，故最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(x-3) \cdot(x+2) \\ \cdot(x^2-6) \\ \cdot(x-6)^2\end{gathered}\]。

Let \(g(x)\) be a polynomial divisible by \(x+1\). Then \(g(4x-5)\) must be divisible by which expression?
fields.after: Let \(f(x)=ax^2+bx+c\). If \(f(x+1)-f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x+1\), find \(b\).

fields.before: 設多項式 \(g(x)\) 可被 \(x+1\) 整除，則 \(g(4x-5)\) 必可被下列哪個式子整除？
Since \(g(-1)=0\), solve \(4x-5=-1\) to get \(x=1\). Thus \(x-1\) is a factor.
fields.after: Expansion gives \[\begin{gathered}f(x+1) -f(x) \\ =a(2x+1) +b\end{gathered}\]. Its remainder on division by \(2x+1\) is \(b\), hence \(b=0\).
展開得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x+1) -f(x) \\ =a(2x+1) +b\end{gathered}\]，故除以 \(2x+1\) 的餘式為 \(b\)。可整除表示 \(b=0\)。

Let \(f(x)=2x^2+ax-2\), where \(a\) is a constant. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x-1\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-a\).
fields.after: The H.C.F. and L.C.M. of three expressions are \(6xz\) and \(108x^3y^2z^2\) respectively. The first two expressions are \(54x^3yz\) and \(18x^2y^2z\). Which is the third expression?

fields.before: 設 \(f(x)=2x^2+ax-2\)，其中 \(a\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(2x-1\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 除以 \(x-a\) 的餘式。
fields.after: 三式的最大公因式及最小公倍式分別為 \(6xz\) 及 \(108x^3y^2z^2\)。首兩式為 \(54x^3yz\) 及 \(18x^2y^2z\)，第三式是哪個？

fields.before: \(f(\frac12)=0\) gives \[\begin{gathered}\frac12 +\frac a2 \\ -2 =0\end{gathered}\], hence \(a=3\). The required remainder is \(f(3)=18+9-2=25\).
fields.after: For A, the coefficient gcd is 6 and lcm is 108; minimum variable exponents give \(xz\) and maxima give \(x^3y^2z^2\). B has coefficient lcm 216; C leaves at least \(x^2\) in the H.C.F.; D leaves coefficient 18. Thus only A meets both conditions.

fields.before: 由 \(f(\frac12)=0\) 得 \[\begin{gathered}\frac12 +\frac a2 \\ -2 =0\end{gathered}\]，所以 \(a=3\)。所求餘式為 \(f(3)=18+9-2=25\)。
fields.after: 選 A 時，係數的最大公因數為 6、最小公倍數為 108；變量最低指數給 \(xz\)，最高指數給 \(x^3y^2z^2\)。B 的係數最小公倍數為 216；C 的最大公因式含 \(x^2\)；D 的公因數係數為 18，均不符。

Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =2x^3 +px^2 \\ -2qx -25\end{gathered}\], where \(p,q\) are constants. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-5\) and \(2x+1\), find the remainder when it is divided by \(x+1\).
fields.after: The L.C.M. and H.C.F. of two polynomials are \(2x(4x^2-1)(x^2-1)\) and \(x-1\) respectively. One polynomial is \(2x^3-x^2-2x+1\). Find the other.

fields.before: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =2x^3 +px^2 \\ -2qx -25\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(p,q\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-5\) 及 \(2x+1\) 整除，求它除以 \(x+1\) 的餘式。
fields.after: 兩多項式的最小公倍式及最大公因式分別為 \(2x(4x^2-1)(x^2-1)\) 及 \(x-1\)。其中一式為 \(2x^3-x^2-2x+1\)，求另一式。

fields.before: \(f(5)=0\) gives \(5p-2q=-45\). \(f(-\frac12)=0\) gives \(p+4q=101\). Solving yields \(p=1,q=25\). Then \[\begin{gathered}f(-1) = -2 +1 +50 \\ -25 =24\end{gathered}\]
fields.after: The given polynomial factors as \((x-1)(x+1)(2x-1)\). Use product of the two polynomials = H.C.F. × L.C.M. Cancelling gives \[\begin{gathered}2x(x-1)(2x+1) =4x^3 \\ -2x^2 -2x\end{gathered}\].
已知式分解為 \((x-1)(x+1)(2x-1)\)。利用「兩式乘積＝最大公因式×最小公倍式」，約去因式後得 \[\begin{gathered}2x(x-1)(2x+1) =4x^3 \\ -2x^2 -2x\end{gathered}\]。

fields.after: Let \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =x^4 +ax^2 +x \\ +b\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are constants. If \(g(x)\) is divisible by \(3x+2\), find the remainder on division by \(3x-2\).
設 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =x^4 +ax^2 +x \\ +b\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。若 \(g(x)\) 可被 \(3x+2\) 整除，求它被 \(3x-2\) 除的餘式。
The even-power terms cancel in \(g(2/3)-g(-2/3)\). The difference is \(4/3\). Since \(g(-2/3)=0\), the required remainder is \(4/3\).

fields.after: The remainders when a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-2\) and \(x+3\) are 3 and 8 respectively. Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^2+x-6\).
多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-2\) 及 \(x+3\) 除的餘式分別為 3 及 8。求它被 \(x^2+x-6\) 除的餘式。
Factor the divisor as \((x-2)(x+3)\) and let the remainder be \(ux+v\). Then \(2u+v=3\) and \(-3u+v=8\). Solving gives \(u=-1,v=5\), so the remainder is \(-x+5\).

fields.after: A degree-4 polynomial \(f(x)\) has remainders 1, 5 and 3 when divided by \(x\), \(x+1\) and \(x-1\) respectively. Find the remainder on division by \(x^3-x\).
四次多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x\)、\(x+1\)、\(x-1\) 除的餘式依次為 1、5、3。求它被 \(x^3-x\) 除的餘式。
The divisor is \(x(x-1)(x+1)\), so let the remainder be \(ux^2+vx+w\). At 0, \(w=1\); at \(-1\), \(u-v=4\); at 1, \(u+v=2\). Thus \(u=3,v=-1\) and the remainder is \(3x^2-x+1\).
